syncrun_alreadyrunning: {{pluginName}} is already syncing, so {{newTriggerSource}} was skipped.
syncrun_step0: 0/8 Dry run: no files will be changed.
syncrun_shortstep0: 0/2 Dry run: no files will be changed.
syncrun_abort_protectmodifypercentage: Sync stopped: {{realModifyDeleteCount}} of {{allFilesCount}} files ({{percent}}%) would be modified or deleted, reaching the {{protectModifyPercentage}}% safety limit. Check that the server address and remote folder are correct.
modal_remotebasedir_shortdesc:
1. Files are not moved on the server. The next sync starts over with the new folder.
2. Leave it empty to use the vault name.
3. The characters ?, / and \ are not allowed. Leading and trailing spaces are removed.
modal_remotebasedir_invaliddirhint: The folder name contains ?, / or \, which are not allowed.
settings_autorun_desc: Sync automatically at a fixed interval. Uses more battery.
settings_runoncestartup_desc: Sync once after Obsidian starts. Takes effect on the next start.
settings_remotebasedir_desc: The folder on the server that your vault syncs into. Fixed to ObsidianVault_Math on the NextClaw server. After changing it, press Confirm; the next sync compares both sides from scratch.
settings_webdav_addr_desc: The WebDAV server address. Filled in automatically from your username when you use a NextClaw account, so there is no need to change it.
settings_webdav_user_desc: Your account username. Entering it switches from the demo vault to your own storage. If it is left empty, the plugin connects to the read-only demo vault so you can check whether your device can reach Nextcloud over WebDAV.
settings_webdav_password_desc: Your account password or app password. Stored on this device.
settings_webdav_auth_desc: Authentication method of the WebDAV server. Ignored when no password is set.
settings_webdav_depth_desc: Choose depth=infinity if your server supports it, for faster listing. If unsure, choose depth=1.
settings_webdav_customheaders_desc: Some servers need extra request headers. Leave empty if unsure. One per line, for example X-Header1: value1.
settings_debuglevel_desc: Default is Info. Choose Debug to see more detailed progress while syncing.
settings_syncplans_desc: Export recent sync plans as notes in the _nextclaw_debug folder, for troubleshooting.
nextclaw_group_otherwebdav_desc: Only needed when connecting to a WebDAV service other than NextClaw.
nextclaw_guard_demo_body: This vault already has {{count}} files. NextClaw Sync is designed for a new, empty vault. Syncing the demo vault replaces this vault's appearance, editor and core plugin settings, and files with the same names as demo files may be overwritten. When you later enter a username, the items below will be moved to .trash:
nextclaw_guard_demo_advice: We recommend creating a new, empty vault for NextClaw Sync.
nextclaw_guard_switch_body: Before switching to your account, {{count}} files in this vault will be moved to .trash (you can recover them from there). They will not be synced to your account:
nextclaw_guard_cancelled: NextClaw Sync: cancelled, nothing was synced.
nextclaw_guard_manual_required: NextClaw Sync: this vault already has {{count}} files and needs your confirmation. Tap sync once to continue.
